finale/0.text: In the end they compromised. The rectangle kept its corners, the circle kept its curves, and the crown landed on whoever rendered deterministically. Which, here, is everyone. The end.

hook/0.text: This is a rectangle. For years it sat quietly in the corner of the screen, doing absolutely nothing of note.

hook/1.text: But one day it decided it wanted more.

rise/0.text: It learned to move. It learned to grow. It even learned to spin, which frankly alarmed everyone.

rivalry/0.text: Then a circle arrived. Smooth. Confident. Zero corners. The rectangle was not thrilled about this development.
